fixed.explanation: Tracing._captureSnapshot awaits snapshotter.captureSnapshot, which evaluates in the page and never resolves if the main thread is blocked, so the progress timeout is ignored. Wrapping the call in progress.race lets the abort/timeout apply; the existing catch swallows errors, so the race is made to ignore rejection only for snapshot failures and the progress abort is rethrown.

query.intent: Tracing snapshotter captures DOM snapshots before/after actions by evaluating a script in the page; this await is not bounded by the action's progress/timeout, so a blocked main thread hangs the call. Wrap the snapshot capture in the progress controller / race with timeout so the abort applies.
query.symptom: With tracing snapshots enabled, Playwright actions on a page with a blocked main thread hang forever and ignore the timeout.

history.analysis: Results were tests and client code; none show the server-side snapshotter. The server Tracing class's onBeforeCall/onAfterCall calls snapshotter.captureSnapshot, which evaluates in the page and is not raced with progress.
